premises.text: Drug-related deaths and overdoses create urgent, under-served toxicology testing demand
premises.evidence_span: In one in six death investigations is a suspected overdose.

premises.text: A portable lab-on-a-chip platform with a novel recirculation technique runs 100 simultaneous measurements from one drop of saliva in under five minutes
premises.evidence_span: an innovative lab-on-a-chip device that can make up to 100 simultaneous measurements from a single drop of saliva

premises.text: Microfluidics always gets enough sample where strips fail, detects more drugs, and uniquely detects fentanyl at recommended cutoffs
premises.evidence_span: With our microfluidics-based approach, we can always get the right amount of sample to run a test.

premises.text: Forensic toxicology is the launch market because it has immediate need and minimal regulatory burden compared with the decade-long regulated path
premises.evidence_span: So we first launched in the forensic toxicology market, which has immediate need, high growth potential, and has minimal regulatory burden.

premises.text: The roadside law-enforcement test is the leapfrog point into death-investigation and neonatal toxicology markets
premises.evidence_span: This is our leapfrog point to get into other forensic toxicology markets, such as cause of death investigation and neonatal toxicology

value.text: A toxicology lab in a box for clinicians and investigators at the point of need
value.evidence_span: For clinicians and investigators, it is a toxicology lab in a box.

causal_links.evidence_span: There are so many of these things happening that they can't all be investigated.
